result: Fixed an actual centered-phase defect found during FIR-M1 investigation: even-N FIR synthesis retained the unpaired lag -N/2 sample while reporting N/2 delay. Linear design now zeros that endpoint and averages representable pairs before f32 conversion. N taps, latency N/2+32 per stage, parameters/serialized settings and minimum-phase design stay unchanged. Independent streamed DTFT: 4112 non-grid probes from 20 Hz to 20 kHz, four rates 44.1/48/96/192 kHz and all lengths; maximum aligned phase error drops from 9.42126519e-4 to 2.68891455e-7 rad under unchanged 1e-4. Maximum aligned group-delay error 2.0151667e-4 samples under unchanged 0.5. Exact support/symmetry/latency hold in 240 legacy/ordered/auto-gain configurations. Full release crate 145 passed, two existing ignores retained; strict all-target QA Clippy/format pass and existing dynamic/convolution/heap/EOF coverage remains passing. FIR-M1 still fails its unchanged 0.05 dB bound: -0.2462965578 dB versus baseline -0.2457439959. Dense short-filter magnitude error is retained, up to 1.3314987 dB at 192 kHz/1024 taps. Static QA exits zero under its historical 4x jitter gate but records six physical misses; no deadline compliance claimed. Rectangular/log-weighted/reweighted whole-spectrum experiments were rejected and removed; the reweighted patch/raw results are retained. Overall remains 35/45, FIR entry partial.
